methods.name: Sharp RD: local polynomial with CCT (2014) bias correction and robust variance, given bandwidths
methods.reference: rdrobust::rdrobust(y, x, c, p, h, b, kernel, vce, nnmatch, level) 4.0.0
quantities: conventional and robust SE (NN with nnmatch 1/3/5 and tie groups, HC0-HC3)
three kernels, h != b, p = 2, unequal sides
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1000: coefficients 1e-8, SE/statistics/CI bounds 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute, counts exact; observed agreement <= 1.7e-12

deviations.quantity: bandwidths when h and b are not given
deviations.note: p2a's own MSE-type selector, not rdbwselect; every case passes h and b
